description: Buleltins of stations of the Czech regional seismic network CRSN is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by storing.ingv.it. Readings of seismic events (earthquakes, mining induced events, explosions) in the Czech Republec and worldwide of seismological stations of the Czech Regional Seismic Network. Data from 1976 to present are stored in monthly files. Older annual bulletins from 1908 to 1954 are available in the pdf format. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include seismology, seismologie, CzechGeo, geofyzika, geophysics. The listing shows 2 download or service links in TXT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
